section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses limitations of a single study examining body appreciation and related variables. The study used a homogeneous sample of mainly White, young adult, middle-class, first-year college women, and the authors acknowledge that findings may not generalize to other populations. The section also notes limitations including unmeasured variables, correlational design preventing causal inference, recall and measurement error in self-reported data, and recommends future research using longitudinal designs and more diverse samples including men.
